import asyncio, time
from toyapp.async_jobs import run_batch, WORK_DELAY_SECONDS

async def main():
    for size in (30, 50, 50):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        result = await run_batch(size)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
        print(f"size={size} result={result} elapsed={elapsed:.4f}s (serial would be ~{size*WORK_DELAY_SECONDS:.3f}s)")

asyncio.run(main())
